about: Assumptions for the local cost. These are inputs, not measurements. Fill them before `report`; leave null and the report prints the formula with blanks instead of a number. Energy can be measured (optional, needs sudo): in another terminal during `run --local`, `sudo powermetrics --samplers cpu_power,gpu_power -i 1000`, note the typical 'Combined Power' in mW, and enter watts here with power_source set to 'powermetrics, <date>'.
laptop_price_note: what the same laptop would cost to replace today, in the currency above
electricity_note: the household tariff on your own bill, per kWh, in the currency above

formula.energy_cost: energy_kwh × electricity_price_per_kwh   (the marginal cost: the laptop is already paid for)
formula.depreciation_cost: laptop_price / (lifetime_years × use_hours_per_year) × busy_seconds / 3600   (a share of the laptop, if you bought it for this work)
formula.busy_seconds: sum of total_s over the 30 tasks, warm model; the one-off cold load is reported separately
